The file of `x18n typegen` is out of date with the source locale.

The check is on by default, with the severity `error`.



## Configure

Change the severity, or turn the check off, in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from '@x18n/core'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'typegen-stale': 'off',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only typegen-stale` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip typegen-stale` skips it for one run.
